messages:
maria (Docs): Heads-up — found several anchor/link and SDK snippet inconsistencies across the migration guide and SDK examples. PRs affected: #842, #847. Can we align lexicon anchors and standardize snippet casing?
jon (Eng): Seen that. Where exactly are anchors causing the link-check to fail? It flagged 5 broken anchors in migration.
maria (Docs): Specifically: docs/migration/v1-to-v2.md mixes `model-name`, `model_id`, and `model.id` anchors. Also Python SDK samples use `modelName` in some examples and `model_name` in others.
pri (DevEx): Proposal: canonical docs use snake_case for field names (match python/go), JS examples keep camelCase. Add a short style note + script to normalize anchors.
casey (PM): Fine by me, but what's the canonical public term? `model` vs `model_id` vs `model-name` — product teams reference 'model' usually.
luis (Eng-ML): Recommend `model` as canonical identifier (string id like `redwood-1`). Avoid mixing `name`/`id`. Glossary entry: "model — stable model identifier used across APIs".
pri (DevEx): I'll draft glossary blurb and a style paragraph: headings should be plain text, avoid code spans in headings (they change slug generation), and use kebab-case for anchor slugs derived from glossary terms.
maria (Docs): Action items: 1) @pri draft glossary + style note. 2) @jon run anchor-lint and paste failures. 3) @luis confirm canonical term. 4) I'll sweep PRs #842 & #847 for examples. ETA: EOW.
jon (Eng): Running the linter now: `node scripts/check-anchors.js --path docs/migration` — quick note: headings with inline code create slugs with punctuation (e.g., ``## `model.id` `` => `model.id`) so links to `#model-id` fail.
pri (DevEx): Can we avoid inline code in headings? Style suggestion: use plain heading `Model ID` and show `` code in following paragraph. I'll add that to style guide.
maria (Docs): Also found two python snippets using `client.generate(modelName='...')` — switch to `client.generate(model='...')` in canonical docs.
luis (Eng-ML): We'll accept both `modelName` and `model` for a short transition, but formally deprecate `modelName` in 2 sprints. I'll open an engineering note.
casey (PM): Add deprecation note in SDK migration guide so integrators are aware.
jon (Eng): Anchor-lint output: 
- docs/migration/v1-to-v2.md: missing anchor 'model-id' referenced at line 120
- docs/guides/sdk-snippets.md: heading `### modelName` -> slug `modelName` mismatch with `#model-name` links
- docs/faq.md: link to `#model-id` but heading is `Model ID` written with inline code
I'll open PR #855 with direct fixes for those.
pri (DevEx): Draft PRs plan: add style note in `docs/style/terminology.md` explaining heading rules + canonical terms; add `scripts/fix-anchors.py` to suggest replacements; add CI link-check step.
maria (Docs): Who can update the python snippet in `sdk/python/examples/chat.md`? @pri or @jon?
jon (Eng): I can. I'll replace `client.generate(modelName='redwood-1')` -> `client.generate(model='redwood-1')` and push to #855.
luis (Eng-ML): I'll update glossary PR #848 with the canonical `model` entry and example mappings (`modelName` -> `model`), include timeline for deprecation.
casey (PM): When PRs are ready: staged rollout = docs-only review -> run link-check -> merge. @maria can you batch-approve?
maria (Docs): Yes. Also everyone run locally before marking ready: `yarn docs:build && yarn link-check`.
pri (DevEx): I'll add `link-check` CI step (docs pipeline) so regressions are caught in PR checks.
jon (Eng): ETA: PR #855 (anchor fixes + SDK snippet update) ready by tomorrow morning.
luis (Eng-ML): I'll coordinate SDK deprecation messaging with eng leads and add a short note in migration guide.
maria (Docs): Thanks all — I'll track in GH issue and ping this thread for final merge. :sparkles:
